text:
Power is 1.7 µW over budget because the NMOS mirrors (MB, M5, M7) don't copy the intended currents. MB was sized at Vds = 0.6 V but sits at 0.86 V, so M7 carries 321 µA instead of 280 µA. M5 is in triode (Vds 0.165 V < Vdsat 0.208 V). The fix is to size MB at its real Vds and raise the current-source gm/Id to 12 to cut Vdsat. I also cut I6 to 255 µA to restore power margin.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Mirror mismatch (MB sized at wrong Vds) pushed I6 to 321 uA, so power fails. M5 is in triode. Size MB at its own Vgs, raise current-source gm/Id to 12 to lower Vdsat, lower I6 for power margin, and calibrate the slew model."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (16.0, 12.0, 20.0),
    "L1":    (0.6, 0.3, 1.0),
    "Itail": (68e-6, 45e-6, 100e-6),
    "gmidL": (9.0, 6.0, 13.0),
    "LL":    (0.8, 0.4, 1.5),
    "I6":    (255e-6, 150e-6, 290e-6),
    "gmid6": (11.0, 8.0, 15.0),
    "L6":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "Ln":    (0.8, 0.4, 1.5),
    "Cc":    (1.0e-12, 0.5e-12, 1.6e-12),
    "kz":    (1.6, 0.8, 3.5),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    It = p["Itail"]; I1 = It / 2.0; I6 = p["I6"]; Cc = p["Cc"]
    gmid_n = 12.0

    # bias diode sized at its own Vds (= Vgs) so mirrors copy accurately
    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], iref, vds=mb.vgs)
    vgsb = mb.vgs

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.45, vsb=0.2)
    vtail = max(0.12, spec.get("vcm", 0.9) - m1.vgs)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.45, vsb=vtail)
    vtail = max(0.12, spec.get("vcm", 0.9) - m1.vgs)

    m5 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], It, vds=vgsb)
    m7 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], I6, vds=vgsb)

    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidL"], p["LL"], I1, vds=1.1)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid6"], p["L6"], I6, vds=0.9)

    gm1, gm3, gm6 = m1.gm, m3.gm, m6.gm
    Rz = p["kz"] / gm6

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "nd", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "nd", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "n1", "nc", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "nc", "vout", Cc)

    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = gm6 / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    C2 = CL + m6.cdd + m7.cdd
    ugbw = 0.88 * gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    p2 = gm6 * Cc / (C1 * C2 + Cc * (C1 + C2)) / (2 * PI)
    p_mirror = gm3 / (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd) / (2 * PI)
    denom = (1.0 / gm6 - Rz)
    fz = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * denom)
    ph_z = math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / abs(fz)))
    ph_z = ph_z if fz < 0 else -ph_z
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) \
         - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p_mirror)) + ph_z
    swing = vdd - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.1
    power = vdd * (iref + It + I6)
    slew = 0.71 * min(It / (Cc + C1), I6 / (CL + Cc))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "swing": swing,
               "power": power, "slew": slew}
```
